$comment: Its own tool, and not a branch of `write`, because hosts grant permission per tool NAME: one writer would make "you may tick tasks off" and "you may wipe the graph" the same grant. There is no delete_graph either -- an emptied graph is not listed, so emptying IS deleting -- which is why this is the one call with no default handle.
name: reset
title: Reset graph
description: Irreversible. Empties a graph: every task and dependency in it. An emptied graph stops being listed, so this is also how a graph is deleted; the handle keeps working if you write to it again. Only when the user says clear, wipe, start over or delete. Never to make room for a new plan — write(op=plan) merges.

graph.description: Which graph. Required: this is the one call with no defaulting to the most recent.
